BrochureContent.Content:
Situated in the highly regarded Chandlers Rest development in Rushbrooke, this superb three-bedroom, three-bathroom mid-terrace home offers stylish, energy-efficient living in a peaceful, family-friendly setting. Presented in excellent condition throughout, this impressive property combines modern comforts with a host of thoughtful features, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers, growing families or those seeking a turnkey home.

The accommodation is bright and well-proportioned, comprising a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious living room, a contemporary kitchen and dining area with access to the rear garden, a guest WC, three generous bedrooms, including a master with en-suite, and a modern family bathroom.

A particular highlight of the property is the private south-facing rear garden, perfect for enjoying sunshine throughout the day. The garden also benefits from rear gated access onto a green area, an outdoor power point and an outdoor water supply. To the front, there is parking for two cars, concealed bin storage and an additional outdoor water supply.

The home has been designed with modern living in mind and includes zoned HIVE smart heating controls for both upstairs and downstairs, fibre-to-the-home broadband availability, making it ideal for remote working, and an attic suitable for future conversion, subject to the necessary consents. Additional thoughtful features include built-in ironing board storage in the master bedroom.

Chandlers Rest is a quiet cul-de-sac within a welcoming, owner-occupied neighbourhood, offering a safe and community-focused environment. The development is within walking distance of a crèche, Centra convenience store, local shops and the popular Ballynoe Inn, while the recently confirmed Ballynoe Train Station will further enhance connectivity to Cork City and the surrounding areas. Rushbrooke and nearby Cobh offer an excellent range of schools, cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities and scenic coastal walks, while Cork City is easily accessible by both road and rail.

Further benefits include an annual management fee of just €100, representing excellent value for the upkeep of the attractive communal green areas, while the boiler was last serviced in July 2023, providing additional peace of mind for prospective purchasers.

This is an outstanding opportunity to acquire a beautifully maintained home in one of Rushbrooke's most desirable residential developments, offering modern convenience, excellent energy efficiency and an exceptional quality of life.
